page.content:
Son who duels to defend his father's name and dies first.

How Philip Hamilton connects

  • Character: Eliza Schuyler Hamilton — Philip is Eliza and Alexander's son.
  • Character: Alexander Hamilton — Philip dies in a duel defending his father's name.
  • Work: Ten Duel Commandments — Philip follows the Ten Duel Commandments and dies by them.

What is Philip Hamilton?

Philip Hamilton is Eliza and Alexander's son, taught the ten duel commandments, who fires too high and dies — the private cost the public man pays before Weehawken.

Key threads lead to Eliza Schuyler Hamilton, Alexander Hamilton and Ten Duel Commandments.
